name: GarbageCollectedTeardown
summary: Leaves the fixture to the runtime, so that a test that allocated nothing outside memory needs no teardown at all.

roles.name: GarbageCollectedTeardown
roles.summary: A fixture with nothing to clean up, said on purpose. The annotation is a claim rather than a shrug: everything this creates is reclaimed by the runtime, so no file, no socket, no row and no temporary directory is left behind — and the day one appears, the claim is the thing that was broken.
